messages.text:
I can’t credit both now:

- The toothbrush holder must reach the shop before a refund can be requested. It is not recorded as received back (refund-policy/v2/return). Your order’s deadline was November 12, 2026, at 10:00 UTC and has passed, so a request after it arrives would also be late (refund-policy/v2/window).
- The tumbler’s BRL 39.90 refund was already recorded against your original payment, receipt **R-H255-0001**. It cannot be refunded again (refund-policy/v2/remaining).

The receipt records a refund in the shop’s test ledger, not a bank transfer; we cannot promise a credit before your next bill (refund-policy/v2/payout).
